questions.explanation:
This question validates practical expertise in policy-driven, multi-region deployments on GCP using native tooling. It assesses security controls via Binary Authorization, controlled release strategies with Cloud Deploy, automated rollback mechanisms, and least-privilege IAM configuration.

Key Concepts:
- Binary Authorization: attestors and policy enforcement ensuring images are verified before production
- Cloud Deploy: per-region rollout with configurable traffic splitting
- Automated Rollback: traffic shifting to the previous version when thresholds are breached
- IAM: least-privilege bindings for deployer service accounts and attestors

Code Example:
```bash
# Build and push v4 to Artifact Registry
gcloud builds submit --tag us-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/app/v4:latest

# Create Cloud Deploy release
gcloud deploy releases create v4 \
  --delivery-pipeline=my-pipeline \
  --images=app=us-docker.pkg.dev/$PROJECT_ID/app/v4:latest

# Sign and attest with both scanners
cosign attest --predicate type=vuln-scan ...
gcloud container binauthz attestations create ...

# Promote through regions
for region in us-central1 asia-northeast1 europe-west1; do
  gcloud deploy releases promote v4 --region=$region
done

# Rollback via traffic shift to v3
gcloud deploy releases rollback v4 --region=us-central1
```

## Why This Is Asked
Tests practical, beginner-friendly use of Google-native services to automate a nightly job and monitor it end-to-end.

## Key Concepts
- Cloud Run Jobs for batch tasks
- Artifact Registry as image store
- Cloud Scheduler for time-based triggers
- Cloud Logging log-based metrics for failures
- Cloud Monitoring alerting for SLO/alerting
- Least-privilege IAM roles for deployment

## Code Example
```javascript
# Build and push image
gcloud auth configure-docker us-central1-docker.pkg.dev
docker build -t daily-processor:latest .
docker tag daily-processor:latest us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/daily-processor:latest
docker push us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/daily-processor:latest

# Deploy Cloud Run Job
gcloud run jobs create daily-processor --image us-central1-docker.pkg.dev/PROJECT/REPO/daily-processor:latest --region us-central1

# Schedule nightly trigger (requires RUN API access)
gcloud scheduler jobs create daily-processor-schedule \
  --schedule "0 2 * * *" \
  --time-zone "UTC" \
  --http-method POST \
  --uri "https://run.googleapis.com/v1/projects/PROJECT/locations/us-central1/jobs/daily-processor:run" \
  --oauth-service-account-email service-account@PROJECT.iam.gserviceaccount.com

# Manual test
gcloud run jobs execute daily-processor --region us-central1
```

## Follow-up Questions
- How would you extend to handle transient failures and retry limits?
- How would you verify the alerting policy fires correctly without impacting production?

```python
from apache_beam.options.pipeline_options import PipelineOptions
import json

class AddInsertId(beam.DoFn):
  def process(self, element):
    element['insertId'] = element.get('message_id')
    yield element

with beam.Pipeline(options=PipelineOptions()) as p:
  (p
   | beam.io.ReadFromPubSub(subscription='projects/..../subscriptions/..')
   | beam.Map(lambda b: json.loads(b.decode('utf-8')))
   | beam.ParDo(AddInsertId())
   | beam.io.WriteToBigQuery('proj.ds.table', insert_retry_policy='RETRY_POLICY')
  )
```
